**Workflow value representation.** A boundary captures the fixed-codec bytes for the declared type. A faithful detached value re-encodes to exactly those bytes, including ordered collections. Application equality and unencoded CLR members do not define this representation.

### CR-005b Workflow input and state fidelity

Before accepting an input or committing replacement state, the engine SHALL require that its declared fixed-codec representation survives reconstruction byte-for-byte. An unstable submission SHALL fail before start-key binding or instance creation. A lossy replacement produced by running code SHALL fail through its owning execution path before replacing committed state. [AC-328]

### CP-021a DAG input representation fidelity

Run inputs and mapped node inputs SHALL pass the shared declared-type byte-stability rule before admission. Reopening a run retains the binding and integrity checks of CP-021. An invalid mapped value SHALL fail its owning mapping before the child is admitted. [AC-328]
